chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 538: Ji Ning's Sword Dao Breakthrough Amid War
chapter_meta_description: The Grand Xia faces annihilation. Trapped in battle, Ji Ning's desperation ignites a final enlightenment, fully mastering the Grand Dao of the Sword and setting his path to becoming a Pure Yang True Immortal.
og_title: The Blade That Cuts Through Despair
og_description: Ji Ning breaks through to the complete Sword Dao under the crushing weight of war, turning the tide from the inside out.
twitter_description: The Grand Xia is losing. But inside the battlefield, Ji Ning finally masters the Grand Dao of the Sword—and his eyes have changed.

lore_anchors.definition: A major power of the Three Realms, Daofather of the Grand Xia's ruling faction.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a True Immortal; a divine being who has surpassed the Celestial level.
A Seamless Gate True Immortal leading the assault on the Grand Xia; a cold and strategic commander.
A massive war formation requiring powerful immortals as its core, manifesting a temporary god-tier divine spirit in battle.
A powerful Seamless Gate battle formation composed of a thousand Celestial Immortals and a hundred thousand Loose Immortals.
A Seamless Gate war construct; powerful but expendable in large-scale warfare.

surfaces: Five Energies Rising from the Chest
lore_anchors.definition: The culmination of five elemental Daos (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth) that a Celestial Immortal must achieve to ascend to Pure Yang True Immortal.
A Celestial Immortal who has fully mastered a Grand Dao, condensed the Five Energies, and transformed their Golden Core into Pure Yang.
A power naturally manifested by a Sword Immortal at the peak of the Grand Dao of the Sword, preceding deeper essence mastery.
